source: synthetic. Antigravity CLI 1.1.11's tool-permission prompt. The literal
        "requesting permission for:" is upstream's own gate (Herdr's
        antigravity.toml `permission_prompt`) and the "↑/↓ Navigate · enter
        Confirm" footer is captured verbatim from blocked.txt, this CLI's one
        real selection-chrome capture. The three option spellings are the
        synthetic part: no capture of an answered-or-unanswered permission
        prompt exists, because the harvest machine has no Antigravity account
        that can reach a tool call.
why: upstream's `permission_prompt` needs the phrase *and* either "do you want
     to proceed?" or "tab amend" + "edit command", none of which this prompt
     renders. Antigravity is the one provider whose no-match fallback is not
     low-evidence, so without a rule this screen is a full-evidence visible
     idle and the tracker announces a completed turn while the pane sits on an
     unanswered destructive command. See manifests/sidecar/antigravity.toml
     (`sidecar.permission_prompt_blocked`).
